source_title: 2 PCS Recessed Ceiling Spotlights Modern Waterproof Light
description: A modern bathroom photographed from standing eye-level in a centered wide composition capturing the vanity wall and adjacent shower enclosure. The walls are clad floor-to-ceiling in large-format white marble-look porcelain tile with delicate grey veining, creating a seamless and clean white backdrop. The ceiling is smooth flat white plaster with two recessed disc-shaped downlights emitting a crisp bright white illumination that washes the space evenly. The vanity counter is a dark grey polished marble or stone slab with a rectangular undermount ceramic sink and a polished chrome gooseneck basin faucet. A stack of folded light grey hand towels sits at the left edge of the counter. A glass bud vase holding delicate dried or fresh flower stems and a small round terracotta ceramic vessel decorate the counter surface. Above the vanity, a wide three-panel mirrored medicine cabinet with thin black metal frames spans the wall. Beside the cabinet, a narrow open oak veneer wall niche with three shelves holds artisan soap dispensers with craft-label packaging and a small white ribbed vase with trailing green sprigs. To the right, a shower enclosure begins, enclosed by a full-height black steel and clear glass partition panel. The shower hardware is polished chrome — a round overhead rain head on a wall-mounted bar, plus a hand shower on a sliding rail. The mood is crisp, clean, and minimally curated.
